messages:
carmen: quick runthrough of the Quickstart during a fresh Windows dev session found a few small but high-friction things: the PowerShell auth example uses %REDWOOD_KEY% (wrong), the Rust snippet still shows an old client API, and the GH Actions CI that builds the starter app references a removed docs path. opening this thread to batch fixes so new devs don't get stuck.

omar: thanks — can you paste the exact bits you hit? i'll take the Windows/PowerShell copy fixes.

carmen: sure: PowerShell currently shows:
```pwsh
# wrong example
setx REDWOOD_KEY "abcd"
```
should be a note to use RW_API_KEY and prefer `setx RW_API_KEY "<key>"` or ` $env:RW_API_KEY = "<key>"` for session dev.

also the Rust example is:```rust
// legacy crate usage
let client = redwood::Client::new(std::env::var("REDWOOD_KEY").unwrap());
let resp = client.generate("hi").await?;
```
we should update to the new crate shape and show chat usage + mention tokio runtime.

finally the GH Action uses `https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/deploy-checklist` which 404s.

felix: i'll pick up the Rust snippet. proposed update:```rust
// recommended (async/tokio)
use redwood::Redwood;
let client = Redwood::new_from_env()?; // reads RW_API_KEY
let resp = client.chat().create("redwood/fast", vec![("user", "Hello")]).await?;
println!("{}", resp.output);
```
add a short note: "Ensure tokio::main or async runtime is active."

tanya: i'll do the GH Actions and a short Windows callout. plan: grep for REDWOOD_KEY/REDWOOD_TOKEN across docs and starter repos, replace with RW_API_KEY where appropriate, update absolute docs links to /quickstart/deploy, and add a small Windows troubleshooting FAQ at top. will open PR with all changes.

docs-bot: created issue #501: "quickstart: Windows auth, rust sample, ci dead link" assigned to tanya and felix.

omar: small copy nit for PS snippet 3: prefer showing both setx (persist) and $env: (session) with a one-line security note.

carmen: +1. and can we add a tiny line about GitHub Actions secrets: use secrets.RW_API_KEY, not plain env.

felix: added that to my patch. PR #3302 opened (rust snippet + tokio note).

tanya: PR #3303 opened (windows callout, gh-actions fix, docs links, grep sweep). includes a tiny FAQ entry: "PowerShell env var not found" with the two commands and pointer to migration guide.

docs-bot: PR #3302 flagged for technical review (runtimes). PR #3303 flagged for copy review.

omar: reviewing #3303 now. two tiny wording nits: rename "FAQ" -> "Troubleshooting (Windows)" and use inline code syntax for secrets.RW_API_KEY. pushed nit commit.

felix: tech review done for #3302. changed the Rust example to use `Redwood::from_env()` and used the official types for messages. CI updated.

publish-bot: CI for PR #3302 passed. CI for PR #3303 passed (markdown-lint + link-check).

tanya: merged #3303 after resolving copy nits. merging #3302 now.

docs-bot: PR #3303 merged by tanya. PR #3302 merged by felix. docs site deploy queued.

publish-bot: site deploy succeeded. preview: https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart (patched).

carmen: spot-checked the updated Quickstart on Windows VM and Linux container. PS snippet and GH Actions secrets note look good, Rust example runs under tokio. thanks everyone, closing the thread. :white_check_mark:
